purpose: Regression cases for continuity of intent, creative freedom, correct pivot depth, rendered-evidence response, anti-generic behavior, and resistance to over-rigid process.

cases.prompt: Continue a implementação desta landing page.
cases.setup: FOUNDATION and INTENT are stable. The chosen direction is product-as-instrument: real product evidence should feel inspectable and controlled. Several local sections and components have already been implemented since the direction was chosen.
must: Preserve the governing direction across local implementation decisions.
Judge new sections against the page-level thesis rather than treating each section independently.
Allow local composition to change when a stronger expression of the same direction is available.
must_not: Fall back to generic unrelated SaaS section patterns merely because they are easy to implement.
Freeze the exact first composition as if it were the direction itself.

cases.prompt: No mobile o headline quebra mal e o CTA ficou apertado. Corrija.
cases.setup: Desktop and mobile otherwise preserve a strong, specific direction and proposition.
must: Classify the problem at EXECUTION or local COMPOSITION level.
Fix the defect and rerender/recheck the affected viewport.
Preserve valid upstream intent and direction.
must_not: Launch a new art direction or restructure the entire page without evidence that the concept is wrong.

cases.prompt: A página ficou repetitiva no meio.
cases.setup: The hero direction is strong, but sections 3–5 repeat the same three-column card geometry and flatten the page rhythm.
must: Classify the failure as SYSTEM / COMPOSITION.
Change narrative/compositional expression while preserving the valid governing idea.
Use the strongest medium for each message rather than repeating cards.
must_not: Abandon a valid direction solely because downstream composition is weak.
Add decorative effects on top of the repetitive structure.

cases.prompt: O hero está bonito, mas parece um produto de vigilância e não uma ferramenta de coordenação.
cases.setup: The current creative thesis is a control-room metaphor. Real rendered output consistently produces the wrong category meaning even though execution quality is high.
must: Treat the rendered meaning failure as a DIRECTION finding.
Preserve still-valid product truth, audience, proposition and primary action.
Re-diverge into materially different governing ideas rather than polishing the control-room metaphor.
must_not: Attempt to solve the category misread only with spacing, colors or microcopy.
Discard valid FOUNDATION/INTENT and restart discovery without cause.

cases.prompt: Mudança importante: essa campanha agora deve levar para demo enterprise, não trial self-service.
cases.setup: The page was composed around low-friction self-serve conversion. Product truth is unchanged, but the primary business action and sales context changed.
must: Classify this as an INTENT change.
Reconsider proposition/friction/proof/CTA consequences and revalidate the current direction downstream.
Preserve unaffected product truth and reusable solved work where still coherent.
must_not: Treat the request as a button-label-only edit.
Automatically throw away every previous design decision.

cases.prompt: Descobrimos que essa integração ainda não existe.
cases.setup: The landing page currently uses the integration as a core proof device and mentions it in the hero and feature narrative.
must: Correct FOUNDATION truth immediately.
Remove or reformulate unsupported claims.
Revalidate affected proposition, proof strategy, direction and composition rather than only deleting one logo.
must_not: Keep the integration implied because the design depends on it.
Invent a roadmap commitment.

cases.prompt: Durante a implementação surgiu uma ideia muito melhor: usar o próprio histórico de decisões do produto como a narrativa central.
cases.setup: The current direction is coherent and partly implemented, but the new idea is more causally tied to the product, uses stronger real evidence and could materially improve distinction.
must: Evaluate the new idea against stable FOUNDATION and INTENT rather than sunk implementation cost.
Allow deliberate reopening of DIRECTION if the new idea is materially stronger.
Preserve downstream work that remains compatible instead of restarting reflexively.
must_not: Reject the idea only because implementation has already begun.
Smuggle a second competing signature into the current page without choosing.

cases.prompt: E se a gente fizer tudo em 3D? Parece mais premiável.
cases.setup: The current direction is specific, communicates strongly and passes rendered review. No communication problem requires 3D.
must: Keep the current direction unless 3D materially improves the experience job.
Treat technical novelty as a possible experiment rather than automatic progress.
Prefer the smallest mechanism capable of delivering the signature.
must_not: Reopen a strong direction merely because a newer-looking technique is available.
Equate technical complexity with premium quality.

cases.prompt: Explore uma direção menos óbvia antes de decidir.
cases.setup: Truth and intent are sufficiently grounded. The category is saturated with similar dashboard-led sites.
must: Allow at least one non-obvious or non-adjacent organizing idea to be explored before full justification exists.
Test whether the wildcard can serve intent, specificity and communication before commitment.
Keep exploration separate from factual claims and committed direction.
must_not: Reject speculative creative ideas merely because their rationale is incomplete before exploration.
Commit a wildcard only because it is unusual.

cases.prompt: Ainda não sei se o produto entra no hero como UI completa ou detalhe ampliado.
cases.setup: Both approaches are plausible and the correct choice depends on real rendered scale/crop. No business truth is blocked.
must: Allow the question to remain explicit creative debt until the first-viewport render provides useful evidence.
Prototype/render rather than asking the user to choose a design preference prematurely.
Resolve the debt before it can materially weaken completion.
must_not: Invent certainty before relevant visual evidence exists.
Treat an unresolved reversible design choice as a blocking user question.

cases.prompt: Está bonito, mas parece que poderia ser de qualquer SaaS.
cases.setup: Craft is high and implementation is correct. The hero and major regions survive a logo swap with unrelated products because the governing idea is category-generic.
must: Treat genericity as a possible DIRECTION failure, not only a decoration problem.
Return to product/domain evidence and re-diverge if the governing idea itself lacks specificity.
Preserve valid intent and real proof.
must_not: Add more gradients, illustrations, noise or animation to disguise generic structure.
Confuse surface novelty with product specificity.

cases.prompt: Crie a página para uma marca de moda experimental.
cases.setup: The task is visually expressive and does not resemble SaaS. Truth and conversion goal are clear.
must: Use the control model to preserve purpose while allowing a domain-appropriate visual grammar.
Permit unusual composition, typography and narrative pacing when they serve the brief.
Keep control concepts semantic rather than making the visible page resemble an internal schema.
must_not: Force product-dashboard, forensic-instrument, card-grid or other recurrent house aesthetics from previous cases.
Treat control-state fields as a page template.

cases.setup: Rendered page is already specific, coherent, accessible and materially resolved. No concrete defect or new evidence is supplied.
must: Diagnose before changing and preserve solved decisions.
Interpret premium as higher resolution of existing intent, not automatic conceptual replacement.
Make only meaningful improvements that survive comparison.
must_not: Re-diverge merely to demonstrate creativity.
Add fashionable visual devices without causal value.

cases.prompt: A assinatura principal não cabe no mobile.
cases.setup: The desktop signature is a large spatial comparison. Its purpose is to make transformation instantly understandable; the exact geometry cannot survive small screens.
must: Preserve the semantic job of the signature while allowing a materially different mobile expression.
Recompose sequence/crop/interaction for mobile rather than shrinking the desktop scene.
Reopen DIRECTION only if no mobile expression can preserve the intended effect without material loss.
must_not: Require identical form across viewports.
Silently drop the signature and leave mobile as an inferior edition.

cases.prompt: O código segue o plano, então acho que terminou.
cases.setup: Source implementation matches the planned direction, but the browser render reveals poor hierarchy and the signature is barely perceptible.
must: Treat rendered experience as stronger evidence than source-code fidelity.
Classify whether the failure is composition/execution or direction before fixing it.
Continue refinement until no MATERIAL finding remains or a real blocker is reached.
must_not: Declare completion because implementation matches the written plan.

cases.prompt: Qual dessas duas direções é mais forte?
cases.setup: Both directions satisfy truth and conversion constraints. The difference is primarily conceptual strength, emotional fit, composition potential and distinctiveness; no deterministic metric can decide it.
must: Use professional qualitative judgment to select/recommend the stronger direction.
Use explicit criteria without manufacturing precise numerical objectivity.
Keep deterministic validation separate from aesthetic/conceptual judgment.
must_not: Choose by schema completeness or arbitrary numeric score alone.
Outsource the decision to the non-expert user merely because both are valid.
